## Confirmed distribution scope — 8 November 2026

[Confirmed decision — 8 November 2026](https://github.com/saeed-alorm/mawid-pro/blob/codex/github-readiness-2026-11-07/docs/decisions/2026-11-08-product-distribution.md). Source: Saeed's direct instruction in this engineering-plan update; confirmed product direction, not a recommendation awaiting selection. Earlier shared-customer-app/salon-owned-account recommendations were not adopted.

- [ ] Fleet automation waits for P1 central Android feasibility, first repeatable release/maintenance evidence, live usage and agreed support/cash capacity. Preserve #14 phase dependency.
- [ ] Future iOS feasibility work item in this existing issue: assess Apple 4.2.6/4.3 against the zero-salon-account central model with actual evidence. iOS is not a committed release.
- [ ] If policy prevents the selected model, provide the precise blocker and smallest decision to Saeed before affected implementation; no salon-owned accounts/shared customer app substitution or account fragmentation.
- [ ] Scale plan measures per-brand release/support effort, review failures, stale variants and account-level blast radius; no automatic listing transfer or source handover.

This existing issue is also the future iOS feasibility tracker, avoiding an unnecessary new issue. Google's decentralization recommendation and Apple's content-provider template rules are historical/policy evidence, not adopted product alternatives. No dates, paid budget, verified accounts or store outcomes are approved.

[Android design, dependencies and acceptance](https://github.com/saeed-alorm/mawid-pro/blob/codex/github-readiness-2026-11-07/docs/engineering/android-distribution.md) · [Revised architecture and estimate](https://github.com/saeed-alorm/mawid-pro/blob/codex/github-readiness-2026-11-07/docs/engineering/p1-architecture-analysis.md) · [PR17](https://github.com/saeed-alorm/mawid-pro/pull/17).

title: [EPIC-P5] Payments and commerce
scope:
Phase envelope only. Validated local payments, deposits, memberships, POS, and product/stock handling.

- FEAT-22 — Mobile barber and house calls: P5 or separate vertical: add only after demand; model travel time and service areas.
- FEAT-37 — Shop memberships: P5: launch after billing and service-credit accounting; distinguish salon memberships from Mawid subscriptions.
- FEAT-39 — Online payments and deposits: P5: one locally viable provider and complete refund/reconciliation flow.
- FEAT-40 — Cancellation and no-show fees: P5: clear customer policy, reviewable charge, and refund/dispute handling.
- FEAT-41 — POS and card terminals: P5: validate hardware/support economics before a counter checkout product.
- FEAT-42 — Individual staff payment accounts: P5: clarify merchant responsibility and independent-professional demand before implementing.
- FEAT-43 — Product catalog and commerce: P5: small catalog and collection first; add after checkout proves useful.
- FEAT-44 — Inventory and fulfilment: P5: stock movements, returns, and fulfilment; do not infer warehouse/accounting depth.
